mapper.select: SELECT c.*, o.wo_no, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.unit FROM fin_wo_cost c JOIN mes_work_order o ON o.id = c.wo_id JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = o.material_id WHERE c.period = #{period} ORDER BY o.wo_no
